text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is Wonder Acute's fatigue due to hard 
training? To investigate, the two decided 
to run together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After their joint run, T.M. Opera O judged 
that Wonder Acute was in "perfect health." 
She decided it would be fine to train her 
harder than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her Trainer, however, grew anxious due to 
past experiences. What if the grueling 
training regimen ended up breaking her? 
What if they were wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Wonder Acute seemed to have an 
idea why she tired so easily, but found it 
difficult to open up to her Trainer about 
it.
